_comment: Host-specific management restrictions; review actual operator and official access sources before application. candidate_services are dependency notes, not enforced allowlists. Linux/Windows preserve non-SSH ports; VyOS protects selected-interface IPv4 SSH; PAN-OS restricts all dedicated MGT services. See docs/hardening.md.

rocky-ecom.note: HTTP/HTTPS (and FTP) are candidate scored services; never close them. Restrict SSH mgmt only.

ubuntu-email.note: SMTP/POP3/IMAP/webmail are candidate scored services; never close them. Restrict SSH mgmt only.

debian-splunk.note: Splunk query endpoint is a candidate scored service; never close it. Restrict SSH mgmt only.

kali.note: Kali is on 172.17.0.0/24 and is a trusted operator host; keep it reachable for SSH.

ubuntu-workstation.note: Workstation; SSH is candidate-only. Restrict SSH mgmt to the management LAN.

2022-ad.note: DNS and AD services are candidate scored dependencies; never close them. Restrict SSH mgmt only.

2019-mssql.note: SQL Server is a candidate scored service; never close it. Restrict SSH mgmt only.

windows11-workstation.note: Workstation; SSH is candidate-only. Restrict SSH mgmt to the management LAN.

vyos.note: Restrict SSH on the internal-facing interface only; never touch NAT, routes, forwarding or ICMP.

palo-alto.note: Dedicated MGT permitted-address restriction for all management services, not a transit security rule. Requires console and baseline snapshot. Data-interface management profiles are separate.
